name: Page header with tabs
summary: The top of a record page: breadcrumb, title with a favourite star and summary chips, two actions, and an underline tab bar with counts that scrolls on its own when narrow.
use: at the top of a record page with several tabs
a11y: Breadcrumb is a labelled nav with aria-current; the star is a toggle button with aria-pressed; tabs are a tablist with roving focus (arrow keys, Home, End).

use_when: a record such as a company, deal or project whose content splits into sections with counts
avoid_when: moving between top-level areas of an app: use sidebar-nav
a person's public profile with photos and followers: use profile-hero
a header for a list with filters rather than one record: use filter-bar

parts.name: breadcrumb
parts.what: the path to this record; the last item is the current page and is hidden on a phone

parts.name: mark
parts.what: the record's initials in a tile, hidden on a phone

parts.name: star
parts.what: a favourite toggle beside the title

parts.name: summary
parts.what: one summary chip: an icon or small photo, a label and a bold value

parts.name: tabs
parts.what: one section tab with an icon and an optional count

parts.name: more
parts.what: a More button that appears when some tabs are out of view and scrolls the row

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the record fails to load, keep the breadcrumb and put an alert-banners notice where the title row is

disabled.how: for someone who cannot act on the record, set disabled on the two action buttons and add a :disabled style

overflow.how: tabs scroll sideways in their own row, the clipped edge fades, and a More button appears while some are out of view

long_text.how: the title balances its lines and breaks long words; tab and button labels never wrap; summary chips wrap to new lines

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the breadcrumb links, the favourite star, Add to list, Compose email, then the selected tab, then More when it is shown
Enter or Space on the star adds or removes the favourite
In the tab row, Left and Right arrows move to and select the previous or next tab, wrapping at the ends; Home and End go to the first and last tab
